user.title: Frigate Privacy
user.description: Registers the Frigate Privacy integration. Schedules and paused-camera state are stored server-side, and the bundled Lovelace card is loaded automatically.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of this integration is allowed.

init.title: Frigate Privacy
init.description: Notifications are optional. Choose Home Assistant or an available channel/device under Destination, then choose the events. If your phone is missing, configure its notifications in Home Assistant first. Save, return to the Frigate Privacy card, refresh saved settings, and choose Send test. Notifications do not require trusted automations. Trust only automations and scripts that you have reviewed: this allows their system actions to control privacy without a user session.
